label: Stablecoin & Token Regulatory Framework
description: Classify digital tokens under the MiCA taxonomy (EMT, ART, utility token, other) and assess all applicable regulatory obligations. Covers whitepaper requirements, reserve asset policies, redemption rights, significant token designation thresholds, and the EMT/ART issuer authorisation process.

modelTier.notes: Token classification has major legal consequences. Accurate article citations are essential.

claudeKnowledge.description: MiCA Titles III and IV, EBA EMT/ART guidance, ECB stablecoin opinions, FSB crypto reports, ESMA Q&A

options.label: Token classification — is this an EMT, ART, utility token, or financial instrument?
Whitepaper review — check content against MiCA requirements
Reserve asset policy — EMT/ART reserve requirements
Full compliance gap analysis for existing token
Significant token preparation — EBA assessment readiness

guidedInputs.label: Token Type (if known)
guidedInputs.description: What type do you believe the token is? Select 'unsure' if classification is the question.

options.label: E-Money Token (EMT) — single fiat currency peg
Utility token — access to goods or services
Potentially a financial instrument (MiFID II scope)

guidedInputs.label: Stabilisation Mechanism
guidedInputs.description: How is the token's value maintained? This drives the EMT vs. ART classification.

guidedInputs.label: Issuer's Current Regulatory Status
guidedInputs.description: EMT issuers must already hold an EMI or bank licence. ARTs need NCA authorisation.

options.label: Applying for EMI / bank licence in parallel

guidedInputs.label: Expected Token Scale
guidedInputs.description: Scale affects whether the significant token enhanced regime (EBA direct supervision) could apply.

guidedInputs.label: Token Description
guidedInputs.description: Describe the token: what it does, who holds it, what rights it confers, and how it is stabilised. The more detail, the better the classification analysis.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. EUR-pegged stablecoin backed 1:1 by euro deposits in segregated bank accounts. Holders can redeem at any time at par. Used for DeFi collateral and cross-border payments. Issued by our Irish EMI subsidiary...
